headline: SKIL Infrastructure Limited: Eighth Committee of Creditors Meeting in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: SKIL Infrastructure Limited held its eighth Committee of Creditors (CoC) meeting on 24 July 2026, with post facto intimation filed to NSE as per CIRP disclosure requirements under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
detail: SKIL Infrastructure Limited, an infrastructure sector entity, has been undergoing a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The eighth CoC meeting convened on 24 July 2026 represents a progression in the creditor engagement process, with the Insolvency Professional mandated to file post facto intimation to the stock exchange (NSE) within prescribed timelines. The frequency of CoC meetings typically reflects negotiation rounds on the resolution plan, haircuts, and recovery prospects. This filing confirms ongoing CIRP proceedings and the company's status as a corporate debtor under the IBC framework.
